subject.title: [Feature]: Goal continuance — per-turn goal context + QA continuance scenarios

question: Should active session goals be injected into every agent turn as bounded per-turn context, and should the QA contract include live later-turn followthrough?
rationale: This changes prompt behavior for every active-goal session and touches cache-sensitive inbound context, so the exact contract needs maintainer intent before automation implements it.

options.title: Adopt bounded active-goal context
options.body: Inject only active goals in user-role per-turn context and add source/mock plus live QA scenarios for continuance.

options.title: QA-only first
options.body: Add scenarios that expose the current gap before deciding whether automatic active-goal injection is the right behavior.

options.title: Defer goal continuance
options.body: Keep goals as explicit `/goal` and tool state for now, accepting that agents may need user nudges on later turns.

recommendation.title: Adopt bounded active-goal context
recommendation.body: Inject only active goals in user-role per-turn context and add source/mock plus live QA scenarios for continuance.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored the current goal surface and opened this product follow-up, making him the clearest owner for the prompt contract decision.
